answer: Re-attestations are stored in haven and vine lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the lagoon graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1158 impostors cost 1588 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
